ocr_script_content = '''import pymupdf
import pytesseract
from PIL import Image
import io
import os
import json

pdf_path = "testbed/docs/handbook.pdf"
os.makedirs("output", exist_ok=True)

doc = pymupdf.open(pdf_path)
page = doc[0]  # first page

results = {}

# Approach 1: Get text directly from the page (vector text)
page_text = page.get_text("text").strip()
results["direct_text"] = page_text
print(f"=== Direct text extraction from page 1 ===")
print(f"Text: '{page_text}'")
print(f"Length: {len(page_text)} chars")
print()

# Approach 2: Extract embedded images and OCR each
image_list = page.get_images(full=True)
print(f"=== Embedded images on page 1: {len(image_list)} ===")

ocr_texts = []
for idx, img_info in enumerate(image_list):
    xref = img_info[0]
    base_image = doc.extract_image(xref)
    image_bytes = base_image["image"]
    image_ext = base_image["ext"]

    img_path = f"output/page1_embedded_{idx}.{image_ext}"
    with open(img_path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(image_bytes)

    pil_image = Image.open(io.BytesIO(image_bytes))
    w, h = pil_image.size
    print(f"Image {idx}: {img_path} ({image_ext}, {w}x{h}, {len(image_bytes)} bytes)")

    ocr_text = pytesseract.image_to_string(pil_image).strip()
    ocr_texts.append(ocr_text)
    print(f"  OCR text: '{ocr_text}'")
    print()

results["embedded_image_ocr"] = ocr_texts

# Approach 3: OCR on the full rendered page image
if os.path.exists("output/page1.png"):
    rendered_img = Image.open("output/page1.png")
    rendered_ocr = pytesseract.image_to_string(rendered_img).strip()
    results["rendered_page_ocr"] = rendered_ocr
    print(f"=== OCR on rendered page1.png ({rendered_img.size}) ===")
    print(f"Text: '{rendered_ocr}'")
    print()

# Approach 4: Render at higher DPI for better OCR
mat = pymupdf.Matrix(3, 3)  # 3x zoom = ~216 DPI
pix = page.get_pixmap(matrix=mat)
hires_path = "output/page1_hires.png"
pix.save(hires_path)
hires_img = Image.open(hires_path)
hires_ocr = pytesseract.image_to_string(hires_img).strip()
results["hires_ocr"] = hires_ocr
print(f"=== OCR on high-res render ({hires_img.size}) ===")
print(f"Text: '{hires_ocr}'")
print()

doc.close()

# Determine best result
best_text = hires_ocr or rendered_ocr if 'rendered_ocr' in dir() else hires_ocr
if not best_text:
    best_text = page_text  # fallback to direct text
if not best_text:
    for t in ocr_texts:
        if t:
            best_text = t
            break

results["best_text"] = best_text
print(f"=== BEST TEXT RESULT ===")
print(best_text)

# Save results
with open("output/ocr_result.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(best_text)
print(f"\\nSaved to output/ocr_result.txt")

with open("output/ocr_all_results.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
print("Saved all results to output/ocr_all_results.json")
'''
await write_file("./ocr_comprehensive.py", ocr_script_content)
print("Script written successfully.")

ocr_run = await run_command("python ./ocr_comprehensive.py")
print(ocr_run)

ocr_final = await read_file("./output/ocr_result.txt")
print(ocr_final)

all_results = await read_file("./output/ocr_all_results.json")

verify_excel = await run_command("python3 skills/OfficeBench/tools/excel/read_file.py --file_path /workspace/output/ocr_output.xlsx")
